[font=Tahoma]Installation[/font][/size]

[font=Tahoma][size=4]Manual Installation
[/size][/font][list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the files.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract the archive and paste the folders into the corresponding mod folders.[/size]
[list]
[*][i][color=#f4cccc][size=2]I recommend backing up the original files before replacing anything.[/size][/color][/i]
[/list][*][size=2]When prompted, choose "Replace" to overwrite the original textures.[/size]
[/list]
[font=Tahoma][size=4]For CP (GMCM only)[/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the CP version.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=2]Select your desired interface through GMCM.[/size]
[list]
[*][i][color=#f4cccc][size=2]If you don’t have GMCM, you'll need to edit the config file manually.[/size][/color][/i]
[/list][/list]
